_comment: AI-LOGIX Hazard, Operational & Data Thresholds (Phase 2 Cases T1–T29). Labelled 'Simulated demo values' until validated against official sources such as IMD or CWC.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Cloudburst
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Rainfall intensity >= 100 mm/h over localized mountain micro-basin
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Move to higher ground. Essentials go by drone.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Flash Flood
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: River gauge above danger level (CWC +1.8m), soil saturation >= 80%
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Avoid river crossings. Stay off low roads.

weatherDisasterCases.name: GLOF (Glacial Lake Outburst)
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Moraine dam breach alert or abnormal glacial melt surge signal
weatherDisasterCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Valley transit suspended ➔ Ridge Rail / Drone

weatherDisasterCases.name: Avalanche
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Heavy fresh snow >= 40 cm, steep slope >= 25°, rising ambient temperature
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Do not use the pass. Wait for clearance.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Landslide
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Model probability >= 75% from rainfall x slope x soil saturation
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Take the alternate route shown on the map.

weatherDisasterCases.name: River Bank Erosion
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Sustained high discharge near barge landing jetty or approach embankment

weatherDisasterCases.name: Cyclone
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Official IMD warning, sustained wind speeds > 65 km/h
weatherDisasterCases.recommendedModeSwitch: All suspended during storm ➔ Rail ➔ Road
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Shelter in place. Resume only after all-clear.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Heatwave / Sandstorm (Thar)
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Ambient temperature >= 45°C or horizontal visibility < 500 m
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Move cargo at night. Carry extra water.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Dense Fog
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Visibility < 200 m on riverine delta or mountain highway
weatherDisasterCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Road slows ➔ Drone grounded ➔ Rail slows

weatherDisasterCases.name: Snowfall Pass Closure
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Highway pass flagged closed by BRO / snow depth >= 50 cm
weatherDisasterCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Road blocked ➔ Drone for urgent supplies
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Pass closed. Use drone for urgent supplies.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Earthquake
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Seismic magnitude >= 5.5 on Richter scale near corridor
weatherDisasterCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Hold Road/Rail until bridge scan ➔ Drone first
weatherDisasterCases.plainLanguageAction: Inspect bridges and track before moving.

weatherDisasterCases.name: Forest Fire
weatherDisasterCases.triggerCondition: Active thermal fire hotspot within 5 km of transit route
weatherDisasterCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Road diversion ➔ Drone no-fly near smoke

operationalCases.name: All Modes Unavailable
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Road, Rail, Waterway, and Drone all blocked simultaneously
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Stage supplies, request air support through state authority, escalate.

operationalCases.name: Drone Grounded
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Wind > 55 km/h, battery < 20%, NavIC lost, or altitude > 4,200m
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Drone cannot fly. Use the ground option shown.

operationalCases.name: Barge Stranded
operationalCases.triggerCondition: River depth below minimum draft (< 1.2 m)
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Barge held. Cargo rerouted by road.

operationalCases.name: Rail Line Breached
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Track ballast washout or boulder blockade reported

operationalCases.name: Fuel Shortage
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Depot diesel reserve < 3 days of supply
operationalCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Prefer Rail or Drone; consolidate loads

operationalCases.name: Convoy Breakdown
operationalCases.triggerCondition: No telemetry ping or forward movement for > 45 mins
operationalCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Dispatch relief vehicle ➔ Reroute remaining cargo
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Send relief vehicle to last known position.

operationalCases.name: Communication Blackout
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Cellular network offline; no heartbeat beyond 60 mins
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Unit offline. Follow the saved plan.

operationalCases.name: Multiple Simultaneous SOS
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Distress ticket count exceeds available vehicle fleet capacity
operationalCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Triage queue assigns scarce modes to highest score first

operationalCases.name: Conflicting Priorities
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Two outposts request the same emergency vehicle simultaneously
operationalCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Higher triage score wins; tie broken by ETA then vulnerability
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Officer may override. Override is logged in audit log.

operationalCases.name: Partial Delivery
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Requisition demand exceeds single vehicle payload ceiling
operationalCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Split load across modes (Life-saving via UAV, bulk via convoy)
operationalCases.plainLanguageAction: Part delivered now, rest on next trip.

operationalCases.name: Stock-out at Depot
operationalCases.triggerCondition: Depot inventory reaches zero days of supply
operationalCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Automated resupply requisition from nearest regional depot

dataCases.name: Missing DEM Tile
dataCases.triggerCondition: SRTM GeoJSON tile for target coordinate quad is missing or unindexed
dataCases.plainLanguageAction: Show 'terrain data unavailable', fall back to coarse estimate, label as approximate.

dataCases.name: Unknown SHRUG Key
dataCases.triggerCondition: Officer searches or imports a settlement shrid not present in database
dataCases.plainLanguageAction: Reject politely, suggest the closest matching settlement, never crash.

dataCases.name: Duplicate Settlements
dataCases.triggerCondition: Multiple records share identical name, district, and coordinates within 50m
dataCases.plainLanguageAction: Detect and merge or flag in the data layer, and show the count.

dataCases.name: Outdated Weather Feed
dataCases.triggerCondition: Open-Meteo cache timestamp exceeds max age (> 6 hours old)
dataCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Switch to offline SQLite weather cache
dataCases.plainLanguageAction: Show 'data is X hours old' warning and switch to offline fallback.

dataCases.name: Sensor Outlier
dataCases.triggerCondition: Sensor telemetry outside physically plausible domain (e.g. rain > 300 mm/h)
dataCases.recommendedModeSwitch: Exclude reading from ensemble & flag as suspect
dataCases.plainLanguageAction: Flag, exclude from the model, and show the reading as suspect.

dataCases.name: User Enters Impossible Values
dataCases.triggerCondition: User inputs negative rainfall, slope > 90°, or negative distance
dataCases.plainLanguageAction: Validate before sending, show an inline message with the allowed range.
